ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white/light gray) to 55% low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous regions are located on the distal portions of the lobes. A central low-intensity region extends from the peduncle attachment to the median notch, branching out into a high-density mottling pattern (small dark pixel clusters) within the lighter regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 120 degrees. The depth of the notch occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical extent of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular boundary with frequent low-amplitude jaggedness. Distinct U-shaped indentations are visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe, while the left lobe shows a more continuous, finely serrated topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges follow a smooth convex curve. The trailing edges exhibit a sigmoidal sweep: concave near the median notch transitioning to convex towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several dark, roughly circular pixel clusters (ranging from 3 to 10 pixels in diameter) are distributed across the high-intensity regions of both lobes. A cluster of white circular marks is visible on the dark leading edge of the left tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear pixel streaks are detected. The right lobe shows three prominent parallel diagonal marks (rake marks). The left lobe exhibits several shorter, horizontal and vertical dark linear disruptions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks on the right lobe distal region. Distinct irregular serrations and small notches along the trailing edge suggest prior physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of dark speckling is localized at the interior boundary where the light-intensity region of the left lobe meets the dark central region.
